clips.notes: breathes (with a deeper breath at 1/3), weight L -> R -> L with the hips leading and the chest late, hands loosely together in front, the left hand once smooths the scarf end on her chest; looks at her partner, glances away and back (neck leads, head follows); blinks single, double and slow at irregular times; scarf tail settles after each turn
light young walk, ~106 steps/min: soft hip bob and drop, chest counter-turn, arms swing with lagging forearms and wrists, head steady with a small nod per step; scarf tail swings late

jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm with word gaps (lip sync overrides it); nods on the stressed syllables; first phrase the right hand opens palm-up toward the listener, second phrase the left hand comes to her chest; weight shift; two blinks

head low, shoulders slumped and forward, hands hanging together low in front; slow heavy breathing with one long sigh (rise, hold, sink); looks up at her partner once and down again; slow heavy blinks

a quick breath in, then three firm head shakes that shrink (no!), the shoulders and chest answering a little late, scarf whipping behind; ends chin up and steady, hands coming up toward the chest (next: hold_hands)

pleading: leans in with the left foot a little forward, both hands reach forward at chest height toward her partner 0.12 in front, palms up and open; small pleading pushes on the stressed words (irregular), head tilts and nods, chest heaves with a held-back sob; blinks

arms around her partner standing 0.122 in front (fitted to Naomi's hug at the S02 marks): leans in, right arm over Naomi's left shoulder, left arm round her back lower down, cheek tilted onto Naomi's head; gentle side-to-side rocking (same phase as naomi_hug), one squeeze and a pat on the back, deep breaths

a breath, steps in on the left foot, reaches her right hand to Naomi's left upper arm (0.126 in front, S03 marks), squeezes it, leans in with a head tilt and a smile; then brightens: a little bounce on the toes, left hand opens palm-up beside her (eager); holds with the hand on Naomi's arm

kneeling (both knees on the stubble), right fist holds the handful in front of her lap; two picks per loop at different spots: she looks first, leans and reaches down with the LEFT hand (anticipation lean back), fingers close on a stalk, lifts it, adds it to the handful in the right fist (fist opens a little and closes), straightens, wipes a glance up at the field; breathing, blinks. (The stalks prop is on handR, so the hands are swapped against the contract wording.)
EXTRA (not in CONTRACT §4): stand -> kneel for gleaning, right knee first then left, the right hand closes; ends in frame 0 of glean. Play it before glean when she arrives standing (S04, t 62.54)

from the glean kneel: looks up (at Boaz), sets the left foot forward, pushes up with a hand on the knee, rises, brings the feet together, brushes her skirt once with the left hand; right fist keeps the handful; holds standing

humble and amazed: a breath, kneels (right knee then left), puts her hands together in front of her chest (right fist with the handful inside the left hand), bows the head and chest low; holds, breathing. Ends kneeling (if `shy` follows, play `stand_up` first)

shy: hands clasped low in front, shoulders up a little, head down and turned aside; small sway side to side, the right toe twists on its tip; peeks up at him once (head lifts, holds, drops quickly); quick blinks; scarf sways

happy walk home with the big sheaf hugged in both arms: leans back a little against its weight, the bundle bobs with each step (late), chest counter-turns, head peeks to one side of it, a little bounce in the step; scarf swings
proud: dips (anticipation), lifts the sheaf up and forward to show it, rising onto her toes, chin up and a beaming tilt; small overshoot, settles holding it high in front of her chest; holds
dips, twirls once on her toes (arms out, the scarf tail flies out and catches up late), dips again, a little hop with both hands up, lands softly on bent knees; loops
clips.rootSpin: root bone turns 360 deg about Y during the twirl (no translation)

clips.notes: steps in on the left foot toward Boaz (0.16 away at the S09 marks), small nervous breath, hands clasped at her chest, a little bow of the chest, head tilted, looking up at him; holds with a slow breath
waves to the viewer: right hand up by her head, the forearm sways side to side, the wrist and fingers follow late; body sways and bounces softly on the knees, head tilts; left hand rests at the belt

tired: both hands stacked on the staff planted in front of her, leaning her weight on it; slow deep stooped breathing (the stoop deepens on each exhale), one long sigh (shoulders rise, hold, fall); weight shifts onto the staff and back; lifts her head to look round slowly, drops it; heavy slow blinks; shawl settles

slow tired shuffle, stooped: short low steps with a heavy drop on each, the head bobs and nods late; the staff is lifted and set down every other step (planted with the left foot, so it stays still on the page while it carries weight); the free left arm hangs and swings little; shawl bounces

talks tiredly and lovingly: right hand on the staff at her side, the left hand makes small palm-up gestures on the stressed syllables and once touches her chest; head tilts and small shakes; jaw in an irregular rhythm with pauses (lip sync overrides it); slow blinks
grief: left hand pressed to her chest, head low, a slow 'oh...' sigh (rise, hold, sink deeper), a small slow head shake, right hand on the staff; heavy slow blinks

gentle 'go home': a sigh, the left hand rises palm-out toward Ruth (0.12 in front) and pushes softly twice, head tilted and shaking a little, then the hand sinks halfway and stays offered; right hand on the staff; holds
moved to tears: the left hand at her mouth, head tilting and slowly nodding as she listens, chest catching in small sobs (irregular), a deep shaky breath, right hand on the staff; slow wet blinks

arms around Ruth standing 0.122 in front (fitted to ruth_hug at the S02 marks): left arm round her back under Ruth's arms, the right fist keeps the staff planted at Ruth's side, head resting against Ruth's shoulder; rocks with Ruth (same phase), a squeeze, deep breaths
a tender 'yes': small breath, two nods (the second smaller), the stoop lifts a little and she smiles, left hand comes to the right fist on the staff; settles

'Oh my!': a quick intake of breath, leans back with a little hop back on the heels, the left hand flies up open beside her face, the right lifts the staff off the page; eyebrows up (face); small overshoot; holds with the stoop straighter

joy lifts her: hands come to her chest (gathering), then both arms rise to heaven, the staff held high in the right hand, the stoop straightens, head back, face up; small overshoot and a happy tremble; holds
happy claps in front of her chest (three per loop, the third a touch stronger), bouncing on her knees, head bobbing and tilting with the beat, the stoop lifted; no staff (hidden in S10)

cradles the baby in both arms (left hand under its head, right forearm under its body), rocking it slowly: hips and chest sway, the baby rolls a little late; looks down at it tenderly, once up at the viewer with a smile and back; slow happy blinks; no staff

laughs with her arms open, the stoop lifted: little bounces on her knees, head back on each laugh burst (irregular), shoulders shake, arms open wider on the bursts; no staff in her hand (hidden at the end)

the content landowner: weight on one leg then the other (hips lead, chest late), left hand resting on his sash, broad slow breaths; looks over his field, nods to himself; strokes his beard once with the right hand; blinks; head-cloth and cloak panels settle

confident easy stride: chest out, a strong heel strike and a solid hip bob, shoulders counter-turn, arms swing freely with late forearms; the open robe's front panels swing with the legs and lag the turns; head-cloth bounces

hearty talk: jaw in an irregular rhythm (lip sync overrides it); both hands gesture in turn (right palm-up out to the side, left open in front), nods and a head tilt on the stressed syllables, chest out; weight shift; blinks

'Good morning, everyone!': a breath and a small dip, the right arm swings up high with an open hand (hail), chest out, a big smile; the hand gives one small wave at the top; holds the arm raised; left hand on the sash

'Hm? Who's that?': right hand shading his eyes, leaning forward and a little to the right, head tilted, peering with small adjustments (lean in, hold, tilt the other way, hold), left hand on his hip; a slow curious blink

fatherly: both forearms forward with open palms up, unhurried; on a phrase the right hand sweeps out to his right (toward the water jars), the head tilts, slow nods with the stressed syllables; a warm lean in; jaw rhythm slower (lip sync overrides it); blinks

moved and warm: a breath, the right hand comes to his heart (left side of the chest), a small bow of the head and chest with a gentle overshoot, then straightens a little with a smile; left hand on the sash; holds

comic beat: the big handful in his right fist; shoulders up, a sly glance to his LEFT (leans, holds), a quick glance to his RIGHT (holds), back to the viewer with a cheeky grin, left finger to the lips (shh) and a bounce on his toes; the right hand slides behind his back and at `drop` (3.47 s) the fingers spring open with a wrist flick; then he looks up all innocent, rocking on his heels; holds with the open hand behind his back. Hide boaz/stalks + play stalks_fall at `drop`

'Heh heh': the left hand to his belly, the right hand comes round from behind his back, shoulders shake in uneven bursts (heh-heh-heh, fading), head tips back a little and bobs, eyes crinkle (lids lower); settles into a contented smile; holds
listens kindly: leans in a little with a head tilt, hands loosely together in front, small 'mm' nods at irregular times, one slow tilt to the other side, weight shift; slow blinks
laughs out loud with his arms flung open: bursts that throw his head back (irregular), arms opening wider on each, bouncing on his knees, cloak panels and head-cloth swinging
a big friendly wave: right hand up by his head, the forearm sways, the wrist follows late; body rocks, head tilts; left hand on the sash
